title: MCP server with OAuth sign-in
description: Run an MCP server that ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor connect to with OAuth. Managed Better Auth signs users in on pages the function serves, and each tool call runs as that user against Postgres.

environment.name: MCP_RESOURCE
environment.description: Set this to the public URL of this function's /mcp endpoint, which has the form https://<NEON_BRANCH_ID>-<slug><NEON_FUNCTION_HOST_SUFFIX>/mcp. The neon link command writes NEON_BRANCH_ID and NEON_FUNCTION_HOST_SUFFIX to .env.local. The URL must match the MCP server URL on the branch's OAuth provider.
